headline: Inflation in Mexico accelerated to 3.96% in the first half of November
summary: Mexico's annual inflation rate rose to 3.96% in the first fortnight of November, approaching 4%. Higher electricity prices and vegetables such as tomatoes drove the increase.
why: Inflation data shapes Banxico's interest rate decisions, which influence borrowing costs and the peso.
original_headline: Inflación en México se aceleró a 3.96% en la primera quincena de noviembre
